blocks.t: A study in the American Journal of Health Behavior showed that when  $ \underline{\text{women with obesity}} $ Q39 did Zumba three times a week for 16 weeks, they  $ \underline{\text{lost an average of 1.2 kilos and lowered their percentage of body fat}} $ by 1%. More importantly, the women enjoyed the class so much that  $ \underline{\text{they made it a habit}} $ and continued to attend classes at least once a week – very unusual Q40 for an aerobic exercise programme.
Dance is never going to compete with high-intensity workouts when it comes to physical fitness gains, but its popularity is likely to keep on rising because it's such a fun way to keep fit.
